note: Sac County Conservation Board park (CCB HQ) on the North Raccoon River, 2 mi S of Sac City. Also primitive sites and a seasonal cabin. Indoor restroom at shelterhouse. River is tree-screened from the sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 13 sites with water/sewer/50A, FCFS, $25, May 1 opening; added closing as a season note; note trimmed. Pads on imagery ~270 m from pin; river about 300 m away through forest.
flags: PIN about 270 m off: stored 42.38531,-94.99774 is the park entrance on 280th St. Three gravel pads are visible at the west end of the park road on Esri imagery, loop otherwise under canopy; campground about 42.3832,-94.9960.
Not waterfront holds: from those pads the North Raccoon is about 300 m east through unbroken forest on imagery (scaled from a frame). No water feature at the sites.
Also confirms phone 712-662-4530 (county page). Fees: the county's facility page says primitive camping $15, its Activity page says $15 'per tent'; tent price, not an EKKO base.
